name: Thunderbird
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Thunderbird as the default Omarchy mail client — all 22 stock themes (chrome and message body), privacy defaults, an unread-count bar widget and system-wide mailto registration.

barWidget.description: Unread Thunderbird messages; click to open Thunderbird

features: All 22 Omarchy themes applied with no userChromeJS loader required
Message-reading pane themed from the same palette (userContent.css)
Declarative config: tags, preferences and auto-sort rules in config/
Auto-sort: rules tag and file arriving mail (orders, invoices, newsletters, code)
Comms widget: unread mail + next calendar event; calendar & chat backends
Guard extension: scam-sender and malicious-link warnings, tags suspect mail
Privacy and notification defaults; external GnuPG allowed for OpenPGP
Sets Thunderbird as default mail client at user, system XDG, and Omarchy levels
Starts at login and opens on workspace 4 (silent — does not steal focus)
